summary: This plugin provides a local, auditable memory and knowledge layer for DeepSeek Harness, helping users store preferences, conventions, and lessons for reuse across sessions.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a memory/context management utility for DeepSeek Harness: it provides tools to set up and update long-lived preferences, conventions, lessons, and knowledge entries, then inject relevant items back into sessions. Evidence shows local storage in workspace memory files, changelog-backed changes, snapshots, import/export, and troubleshooting/retrieval flows, so its core purpose is preserving and reusing agent-facing context rather than editing files directly, generating code, or browsing web content.
